attempts.proposition:
∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n → ZMod 3)),
  3 ≤ n ∧
  (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, ∀ c ∈ A,
    a ≠ b → b ≠ c → a ≠ c → a + c ≠ (2 : ℕ) • b) ∧
  A.card > 2 ^ n
attempts.witness_construction: graph of q(x,y)=x^2+y^2 over (Z/3)^2; anisotropic q + identity q(a)+q(b)+q(-a-b)=2q(a-b) mod 3
attempts.body:
⟨3, ({![0,0,0], ![0,1,1], ![0,2,1], ![1,0,1], ![1,1,2], ![1,2,2], ![2,0,1], ![2,1,2], ![2,2,2]} : Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod 3)),
  by decide,  -- 3 ≤ 3
  by decide,  -- labeled: no-3-AP over 9 named points, kernel-decided
  by decide⟩  -- labeled: card > 2^3
